description: List public MFM catalog entries, optionally filtered by kind or verification level, with explicit pagination. Catalog availability does not certify completeness of every financial indicator.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip, for pagination (0 = first page).

verification_level.description: Only companies of this MFM audit level (1, 2 or 3).

version.description: Catalog version returned by the first page; when it no longer matches, the call fails with «Catalog changed» and the listing should restart.

name: list_datasets
title: Browse MFM datasets
